017package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022import java.util.function.*;
023import java.util.regex.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.console.*;
026
027/**
028 * Builder for a {@code switcher} card: one card slot that shows one of several named views, each holding one card or a
029 * strip of sections that each hold a card.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * A view with a single section that has the default id and no model block serializes as a plain {@code card}; any
033 * other view serializes as {@code sections}.  A switcher cannot hold another switcher.  Validation runs in
034 * {@link #toCardSpec()} and is shared with {@link SwitcherCardType} through {@link #validate(String, Map)}, so both
035 * paths report the same messages.
036 *
037 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
038 * <p class='bjava'>
039 *    CardSpec <jv>c</jv> = SwitcherDef.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"revenue-sw"</js>).title(<js>"Revenue"</js>)
040 *       .view(<js>"chart"</js>, <js>"Chart"</js>, <jv>v</jv> -&gt; <jv>v</jv>.section(ChartDef.<jsm>line</jsm>(<js>"revenue-chart"</js>).src(<js>"/console/store/stats/revenue"</js>).toCardSpec()))
041 *       .view(<js>"data"</js>, <js>"Data"</js>, <jv>v</jv> -&gt; <jv>v</jv>.section(<js>"all"</js>, <js>"All"</js>, CardSpec.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"html"</js>, <js>"d1"</js>)).section(<js>"open"</js>, <js>"Open"</js>, CardSpec.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"html"</js>, <js>"d2"</js>)))
042 *       .initialView(<js>"chart"</js>)
043 *       .toCardSpec();
044 * </p>
045 *
046 * @since 10.0.0
047 */
048public final class SwitcherDef {
049
050   /** The grammar of a view or section id. */
051   static final Pattern ID = Pattern.compile("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$");
052
053   private static final String DEFAULT_SECTION = "main";
054
055   private final String id;
056   private String title;
057   private String initialView;
058   private final List<View> views = new ArrayList<>();
059
060   private SwitcherDef(String id) {
061      if (ib(id))
062         throw iaex("SwitcherDef requires a non-blank id.");
063      this.id = id;
064   }
065
066   /** @param id The card id. @return A new switcher. */
067   public static SwitcherDef create(String id) { return new SwitcherDef(id); }
068
069   /** @param v The card title. @return This object. */
070   public SwitcherDef title(String v) { title = v; return this; }
071
072   /** @param viewId The id of the view shown first when nothing else decides. @return This object. */
073   public SwitcherDef initialView(String viewId) { initialView = viewId; return this; }
074
075   /**
076    * Adds a view.
077    *
078    * @param viewId The view id, matching {@code [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}}.
079    * @param label The tab label.
080    * @param config Fills in the view's sections and model block.
081    * @return This object.
082    */
083   public SwitcherDef view(String viewId, String label, Consumer<View> config) {
084      var v = new View(viewId, label);
085      config.accept(v);
086      views.add(v);
087      return this;
088   }
089
090   /**
091    * One view of a switcher.
092    *
093    * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
094    * <p class='bjava'>
095    *    <jv>v</jv>.section(<js>"all"</js>, <js>"All"</js>, <jv>card</jv>).initialSection(<js>"all"</js>).on(<js>"activated"</js>, <js>"orders.shown"</js>);
096    * </p>
097    */
098   public static final class View implements Handled<View> {
099      private final String id;
100      private final String label;
101      private String initialSection;
102      private final List<Section> sections = new ArrayList<>();
103      private final ModelBlock model;
104
105      private View(String id, String label) {
106         this.id = id;
107         this.label = label;
108         this.model = new ModelBlock("view", id);
109      }
110
111      @Override /* Handled */
112      public ModelBlock modelBlock() { return model; }
113
114      @Override /* Handled */
115      public View self() { return this; }
116
117      /** @param card The only card of the view, in the default section. @return This object. */
118      public View section(CardSpec card) {
119         sections.add(new Section(DEFAULT_SECTION, label, card, true));
120         return this;
121      }
122
123      /** @param sectionId The section id. @param sectionLabel The section tab label. @param card The section's card. @return This object. */
124      public View section(String sectionId, String sectionLabel, CardSpec card) {
125         sections.add(new Section(sectionId, sectionLabel, card, false));
126         return this;
127      }
128
129      /** @param sectionId The section id. @param sectionLabel The section tab label. @param card The section's card. @param config Fills in the section's model block. @return This object. */
130      public View section(String sectionId, String sectionLabel, CardSpec card, Consumer<Section> config) {
131         var s = new Section(sectionId, sectionLabel, card, false);
132         config.accept(s);
133         sections.add(s);
134         return this;
135      }
136
137      /** @param sectionId The section shown first when nothing else decides. @return This object. */
138      public View initialSection(String sectionId) { initialSection = sectionId; return this; }
139
140      private Map<String,Object> toMap() {
141         var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
142         m.put("id", id);
143         m.put("label", label);
144         if (nn(initialSection)) m.put("initialSection", initialSection);
145         if (sections.size() == 1 && sections.get(0).implicit && sections.get(0).model.isEmpty()) {
146            m.put("card", sections.get(0).card.toMap());
147         } else if (! sections.isEmpty()) {
148            m.put("sections", sections.stream().map(Section::toMap).toList());
149         }
150         var mm = model.toMap();
151         if (mm != null) m.put("model", mm);
152         return m;
153      }
154   }
155
156   /**
157    * One section of a switcher view.
158    *
159    * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
160    * <p class='bjava'>
161    *    <jv>v</jv>.section(<js>"all"</js>, <js>"All"</js>, <jv>card</jv>, <jv>s</jv> -&gt; <jv>s</jv>.on(<js>"activated"</js>, <js>"orders.sectionShown"</js>));
162    * </p>
163    */
164   public static final class Section implements Handled<Section> {
165      private final String id;
166      private final String label;
167      private final CardSpec card;
168      private final boolean implicit;
169      private final ModelBlock model;
170
171      private Section(String id, String label, CardSpec card, boolean implicit) {
172         this.id = id;
173         this.label = label;
174         this.card = card;
175         this.implicit = implicit;
176         this.model = new ModelBlock("detailtab", id);
177      }
178
179      @Override /* Handled */
180      public ModelBlock modelBlock() { return model; }
181
182      @Override /* Handled */
183      public Section self() { return this; }
184
185      private Map<String,Object> toMap() {
186         var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
187         m.put("id", id);
188         m.put("label", label);
189         m.put("card", card.toMap());
190         var mm = model.toMap();
191         if (mm != null) m.put("model", mm);
192         return m;
193      }
194   }
195
196   /**
197    * Builds the {@code switcher} card entry.
198    *
199    * @return The card.
200    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the switcher is invalid.
201    */
202   public CardSpec toCardSpec() {
203      var vs = views.stream().map(View::toMap).toList();
204      var body = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
205      if (nn(initialView)) body.put("initialView", initialView);
206      body.put("views", vs);
207      validate(id, body);
208      var c = CardSpec.of("switcher", id);
209      if (nn(title)) c.title(title);
210      if (nn(initialView)) c.body("initialView", initialView);
211      c.body("views", vs);
212      return c;
213   }
214
215   /**
216    * Validates a switcher body: the shape the builder emits and the page-contract JSON carries.
217    *
218    * @param id The switcher id, used in messages.
219    * @param body The body holding {@code views} and optionally {@code initialView}.
220    * @throws IllegalArgumentException On the first problem found.
221    */
222   public static void validate(String id, Map<String,?> body) {
223      var who = "SwitcherDef '" + id + "'";
224      if (! (body.get("views") instanceof List<?> views) || views.isEmpty())
225         throw iaex("%s requires at least one view.", who);
226      var viewIds = new HashSet<String>();
227      var cardIds = new HashSet<String>();
228      for (var o : views) {
229         if (! (o instanceof Map<?,?> v))
230            throw iaex("%s views must be objects.", who);
231         var vid = String.valueOf(v.get("id"));
232         if (! (v.get("id") instanceof String) || ! ID.matcher(vid).matches())
233            throw iaex("%s view id '%s' must match %s.", who, vid, ID.pattern());
234         if (! viewIds.add(vid))
235            throw iaex("%s view id '%s' is declared more than once.", who, vid);
236         if (! (v.get("label") instanceof String))
237            throw iaex("%s view '%s' requires a string label.", who, vid);
238         var hasCard = v.get("card") != null;
239         var hasSections = v.get("sections") != null;
240         if (hasCard && hasSections)
241            throw iaex("%s view '%s' takes either a card or sections, not both.", who, vid);
242         if (! hasCard && (! (v.get("sections") instanceof List<?> l) || l.isEmpty()))
243            throw iaex("%s view '%s' requires a card or at least one section.", who, vid);
244         var sectionIds = new HashSet<String>();
245         if (hasCard) {
246            checkCard(who, vid, v.get("card"), cardIds);
247         } else {
248            for (var so : (List<?>)v.get("sections")) {
249               if (! (so instanceof Map<?,?> s))
250                  throw iaex("%s view '%s' sections must be objects.", who, vid);
251               var sid = String.valueOf(s.get("id"));
252               if (! (s.get("id") instanceof String) || ! ID.matcher(sid).matches())
253                  throw iaex("%s view '%s' section id '%s' must match %s.", who, vid, sid, ID.pattern());
254               if (! sectionIds.add(sid))
255                  throw iaex("%s view '%s' section id '%s' is declared more than once.", who, vid, sid);
256               if (! (s.get("label") instanceof String))
257                  throw iaex("%s view '%s' section '%s' requires a string label.", who, vid, sid);
258               checkCard(who, vid, s.get("card"), cardIds);
259            }
260         }
261         var is = v.get("initialSection");
262         if (is != null && ! sectionIds.contains(is))
263            throw iaex("%s view '%s' initialSection '%s' names no section.", who, vid, is);
264      }
265      var iv = body.get("initialView");
266      if (iv != null && ! viewIds.contains(iv))
267         throw iaex("%s initialView '%s' names no view.", who, iv);
268   }
269
270   private static void checkCard(String who, String vid, Object card, Set<String> cardIds) {
271      if (! (card instanceof Map<?,?> c) || ! (c.get("id") instanceof String cid) || ! (c.get("type") instanceof String type))
272         throw iaex("%s view '%s' cards must be objects with a string id and type.", who, vid);
273      if ("switcher".equals(type))
274         throw iaex("%s view '%s' cannot hold a switcher card ('%s').", who, vid, cid);
275      if (! cardIds.add(cid))
276         throw iaex("%s card id '%s' is declared more than once.", who, cid);
277   }
278}
